title: Seven Agricultural Engineering Professionals Receive APEC Engineer Certificates in Yogyakarta
excerpt: Yogyakarta, March 18, 2025 – Seven Agricultural Engineering professionals received APEC Engineer certificates at a seminar held by the Professional Board of Agricultural Engineering of the Association of Indonesian Engineers (BKTP PII) at the MMPT Auditorium of Instiper Yogyakarta. body:
**Yogyakarta, March 18, 2025** – Seven Agricultural Engineering professionals received APEC Engineer certificates at a seminar held by the Professional Board of Agricultural Engineering of the Association of Indonesian Engineers (BKTP PII) at the MMPT Auditorium of Instiper Yogyakarta. The event, which took place on Tuesday, March 18, 2025 at 4:00 p.m. WIB, marked the culmination of the registration and profile activation process that began in June and August 2024. The event was led directly by the Chairman of the Professional Board of Agricultural Engineering (BKTP), Prof. Dr. Ir. Hermantoro, MS., IPU., ASEAN Eng., APEC Eng.

The APEC Engineer certificate recipients are:

1.  Prof. Dr. Ir. Lilik Sutiarso., M.Eng., IPU., ASEAN Eng.
2.  Dr. Ir. Nursigit Bintoro, M.Sc., IPU., ASEAN Eng.
3.  Dr. Ir. Rudiati Evi Masithoh, STP., MDT, IPU., ASEAN Eng.
4.  Dr. Ir. Devi Yuni Susanti, STP., M.Sc., IPU., ASEAN Eng.
5.  Dr. Ir. Radi, STP., M.Eng., IPU., ASEAN Eng.
6.  Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, STP., M.Sc., Ph.D, IPU., ASEAN Eng.
7.  Chandra Setyawan, S.T.P., M.Eng., Ph.D, IPM., ASEAN Eng.

APEC Engineer certification is a professional recognition for engineers who demonstrate high competence and ethical standards, recognized throughout the member economies of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC). This certification enhances engineer mobility and credibility in the Asia-Pacific region.

Prof. Dr. Ir. Lilik Sutiarso, as Chairman of the Department of Agricultural Engineering and Biosystems, welcomed the APEC Eng. certification. "This certification is very important for enhancing the recognition of engineer competence in the Department of Agricultural Engineering and Biosystems at the international level," he said. "This will open up opportunities for broader collaboration and research development."

![](/brand/uploads/notes/387-1-sertifikasi-apec-eng-4-773x1030.webp)

Prof. Dr. Ir. Lilik Sutiarso, M.Eng., IPU., ASEAN Eng., APEC Eng.

Meanwhile, Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, Ph.D, Chairman of the Perteta Yogyakarta Branch, stated that APEC Engineer certification will increase recognition and benefit for Indonesian agricultural engineers in competing at the international level. "With this certification, Indonesian agricultural engineers will find it easier to pursue careers and collaborate with engineers from other APEC countries," he added.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/387-2-sertifikasi-apec-eng-2-827x1030.webp)

Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, Ph.D., IPU., ASEAN Eng., APEC Eng. receiving the APEC Eng. certificate

The seminar not only included certificate presentation, but also a BKTP PII seminar and joint breaking of the fast. A focused group discussion (FGD) was also proposed to discuss enhancing recognition of the agricultural engineering field through BKTP PII, featuring speakers from government, industry, and academia. Several proposals for future activities also emerged, including cooperation with BK Hayati and Perteta Yogyakarta, as well as alignment of themes with UGM's digitalization program.

This achievement is the result of a lengthy process that began with filling out the registration form in June 2024 and continued with profile activation in August 2024. This process involved strict verification of documents and data in accordance with APEC standards.

original.body:
**Yogyakarta, 18 Maret 2025** – Tujuh insinyur Teknik Pertanian menerima sertifikat APEC Engineer dalam sebuah sarasehan yang diselenggarakan oleh Badan Kejuruan Teknik Pertanian Persatuan Insinyur Indonesia (BKTP PII) di Auditorium MMPT Instiper Yogyakarta. Acara yang berlangsung pada Selasa, 18 Maret 2025 pukul 16.00 WIB ini menandai puncak dari proses registrasi dan aktivasi profil yang dimulai sejak Juni dan Agustus 2024. Acara dipimpin langsung oleh Ketua Badan Kejuruan Teknik Pertanian (BKTP), Prof. Dr. Ir. Hermantoro, MS., IPU., ASEAN Eng., APEC Eng.

Para penerima sertifikat APEC Engineer adalah:

1.  Prof. Dr. Ir. Lilik Sutiarso., M.Eng., IPU., ASEAN Eng.
2.  Dr. Ir. Nursigit Bintoro, M.Sc., IPU., ASEAN Eng.
3.  Dr. Ir. Rudiati Evi Masithoh, STP., MDT, IPU., ASEAN Eng.
4.  Dr. Ir. Devi Yuni Susanti, STP., M.Sc., IPU., ASEAN Eng.
5.  Dr. Ir. Radi, STP., M.Eng., IPU., ASEAN Eng.
6.  Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, STP., M.Sc., Ph.D, IPU., ASEAN Eng.
7.  Chandra Setyawan, S.T.P., M.Eng., Ph.D, IPM., ASEAN Eng.

Sertifikasi APEC Engineer merupakan pengakuan profesional bagi insinyur yang menunjukkan kompetensi dan standar etika tinggi, diakui di seluruh wilayah ekonomi anggota Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC). Sertifikasi ini meningkatkan mobilitas dan kredibilitas insinyur di kawasan Asia Pasifik.

Prof. Dr. Ir. Lilik Sutiarso, selaku Ketua Departemen Teknik Pertanian dan Biosistem, menyambut baik adanya sertifikasi APEC Eng. “Sertifikasi ini sangat penting untuk meningkatkan pengakuan kompetensi insinyur di Departemen Teknik Pertanian dan Biosistem di level internasional,” ujarnya. “Hal ini akan membuka peluang kolaborasi dan pengembangan riset yang lebih luas.”

![](/brand/uploads/notes/387-1-sertifikasi-apec-eng-4-773x1030.webp)

Prof. Dr. Ir. Lilik Sutiarso, M.Eng., IPU., ASEAN Eng., APEC Eng.

Sementara itu, Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, Ph.D, Ketua Perteta Cabang Yogyakarta, menyatakan bahwa sertifikasi APEC Engineer akan meningkatkan rekognisi dan kebermanfaatan bagi para insinyur pertanian Indonesia dalam bersaing di level internasional. “Dengan sertifikasi ini, para insinyur pertanian Indonesia akan lebih mudah berkarier dan berkolaborasi dengan insinyur dari negara-negara APEC lainnya,” tambahnya.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/387-2-sertifikasi-apec-eng-2-827x1030.webp)

Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, Ph.D., IPU., ASEAN Eng., APEC Eng. menerima sertifikat APEC Eng

Sarasehan ini tidak hanya mencakup penyerahan sertifikat, tetapi juga sarasehan BKTP PII dan buka puasa bersama. Diskusi kelompok terfokus (FGD) juga diusulkan untuk membahas peningkatan pengakuan bidang teknik pertanian melalui BKTP PII, dengan menghadirkan narasumber dari pemerintah, industri, dan akademisi. Beberapa usulan untuk kegiatan selanjutnya juga muncul, termasuk kerjasama dengan BK Hayati dan Perteta Yogyakarta, serta penyelarasan tema dengan program digitalisasi UGM.

Pencapaian ini merupakan hasil dari proses panjang yang dimulai dengan pengisian formulir registrasi pada Juni 2024 dan dilanjutkan dengan aktivasi profil di Agustus 2024. Proses ini melibatkan verifikasi dokumen dan data yang ketat sesuai standar APEC.
